item.description:
### Added - **Droid sessions that run in the cloud.** Paste a Factory API key in Settings → General and Perch also shows Droid sessions running in Factory's cloud or on another machine: what tool they're using, when they finish, and a "needs you" alert when the agent asks you a question. Your key stays in your Keychain and is sent only to Factory.
### Fixed - **A Droid turn that fails no longer says "finished".** When the model or provider fails, the session shows why it stopped (for example "provider unreachable" or a rate limit) instead of a finish. - **Droid with its sandbox on updates again.** Sessions that run their agent in a separate worker no longer freeze on the list, and their permission prompts reach Perch. - **A Droid prompt queued in the terminal shows as running**, and Perch tells you when it finishes. - A Droid session waiting on a background subagent no longer announces it finished early, and a denied permission reads as idle rather than waiting.
### Changed - Perch does less work in the background while your sessions are quiet, so it uses less of your Mac's CPU.
